description_en: Queries the top 10 protected objects by request count
description_zh: 查看请求量最高的前10个防护对象
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi describe-flow-top-resource --start-timestamp 1665331200 --instance-id waf_cdnsdf30000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeFlowTopResource

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds
parameters.help_zh: 查询的开始时间，单位：秒
parameters.name: start_timestamp

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds. If you do not specify this parameter, the current time is used as the end time
parameters.help_zh: 查询的结束时间，单位：秒。如果不设置该参数，结束时间为当前的查询时间
parameters.name: end_timestamp

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Web Application Firewall (WAF) instance.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html operation to query the ID of the WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例的ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html查询当前WAF实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id

RuleHitsTopResource.description_en: The top 10 protected objects that received the most requests
RuleHitsTopResource.description_zh: 防护对象的流量访问统计Top10

items.description_en: The statistics about requests to the protected object
items.description_zh: 防护对象的流量访问统计情况

Count.description_zh: 指定时间内，防护对象的总请求量
